properties.description: `set_project_mode` chooses a project's `mode` after genesis and can change it later, so the one default that actually alters behaviour stops being asserted by omission. The mode gates exactly one thing — `apply_heal` applies structural repairs in `flexible` and only proposes them in `rigid` — and the schema description now says that rather than the older, broader "design is the source of truth", which promised a breadth the code does not implement. An unknown mode is refused by schema validation and leaves the previous choice intact.
properties.name: The governance mode is a choice a project makes and can revisit
